responsibility: Declares tree-specific pretty-print markup elements used by GCC diagnostics when rendering type names with structured quoting and semantic highlighting. In the pp_markup namespace it defines concrete element subclasses for a quoted tree type and for the specialized expected-type and actual-type variants, coupling tree-aware type printing with the generic pretty-print markup framework and diagnostic highlight-color scheme so richer diagnostic output can distinguish compared types without hardcoding formatting at each call site.
